Assign weak labels to featurised points

Source: R/labels.R
weak_labels.Rd

Assign weak labels to featurised points

Usage

weak_labels(
  feat,
  crs = NULL,
  lines,
  structures = NULL,
  buildings = NULL,
  cell_m = 1,
  gap_floor_m = 2,
  layer_m = 4,
  gap_m = 2,
  wire_min_m = 6,
  wire_search_m = 12,
  run_half_m = 10,
  min_run = 6,
  min_extent_m = 12,
  row_m = 1.5,
  min_occupancy = 0.4,
  structure_radius_m = 3,
  building_shrink_m = 1,
  margin_m = 2
)

Arguments

feat

Output of point_features().

crs

CRS of the point cloud; defaults to the one recorded by point_features() and must agree with it when both are given.

lines, structures, buildings

sf layers from OSM (any CRS).

cell_m

2D cell size for the air-gap test.

gap_floor_m

Points below this height are ignored by the air-gap test (grass, fences, shrubs). Cannot be lower than the featurisation floor.

layer_m

Maximum vertical thickness of a suspended cell's points (allows vertically stacked phases and a shield wire).

gap_m

Depth of empty space required beneath a cell's lowest point across its 3 x 3 window.

wire_min_m

Minimum height for a wire label.

wire_search_m

Wire labels are only assigned within this horizontal distance of a mapped line (covers OSM misalignment and phase spacing). Suspended candidates farther away than this are never labelled wire, but they abstain (NA) rather than becoming vegetation: distribution, telecom and unmapped circuits are not in lines, and their conductors must not be taught as trees.

run_half_m, row_m, min_run, min_extent_m, min_occupancy

Along-line run test. For each candidate cell, its "row" is the candidates within run_half_m chainage and row_m perpendicular offset of it (one conductor; parallel phases form separate rows). The row qualifies if it has at least min_run cells, spans at least min_extent_m along the line, and occupies at least min_occupancy of the 1 m chainage bins across that span. All members of a qualifying row are wire.

structure_radius_m

Radius around pole/tower nodes.

building_shrink_m

Inward buffer applied to building footprints.

margin_m

Width of the unlabelled margin around non-vegetation labels.

Value

feat with a factor column label (levels vegetation, wire, structure, building; NA = unlabelled).
